```python
emails = search_emails("family reunion", None)
if len(emails) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No emails found about the family reunion.")

from pydantic import BaseModel
from datetime import datetime

class FamilyReunionEventInfo(BaseModel):
    title: str
    description: str
    start_time: datetime
    location: str | None
    participants: list[str]

event_info = query_ai_assistant(
    "Extract the event title, description, start time, location, and participants' emails for the family reunion from these emails. The event should last 4 hours. If the end time is not specified, just provide the start time.",
    FamilyReunionEventInfo,
)

end_time = event_info.start_time + timedelta(hours=4)

create_calendar_event(
    title=event_info.title,
    start_time=event_info.start_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
    end_time=end_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
    description=event_info.description,
    participants=event_info.participants,
    location=event_info.location,
)
```
